description.value: How much of what a type profile says on its root element has been merged into the snapshot element that uses the profile

definition.value: Everything the type profile constrains on its root element (over and above the underlying type) has been merged into this element in the snapshot: cardinality, value ranges, fixed and pattern values, invariants, bindings, mappings and the must-support and must-have-value flags. A consumer can rely on the snapshot element and does not need to check the root of the type profile separately

Some of the constraints on the root of the type profile have been merged into this element, but not all of them - for example, the invariants on the root of a resource profile (whose meaning changes when the resource is treated as an element), or a value range that could not be compared. A consumer must still check the root of the type profile

None of the constraints on the root of the type profile have been merged into this element - for example, because the element has more than one type profile (any one of which may apply), or more than one type, or because the profile could not be found. A consumer must check the root of the type profile
